evidence_cutoff_note: the newest cutoff among the faces read; the books inside keep their own cutoff, printed in their producing face
honest: no engine call and no repricing: every word below is a word an earlier face already printed, so a difference is a difference in the rule
R2 can only ever promote a book whose every non-Y4 check is True; a book with an unmeasured (null) check stays where it was, because unknown is not a pass
the cagr column is a reading of the books that would reach ADMIT, not a portfolio return: they are different books read on different panels
the same book is published by several faces (n_readings > n_distinct_names); both denominators are printed rather than picking one
no adoption: which rule should hold is a specification question (the weights and who holds the veto); this page prices the three and ranks none
question: the concentration check downgrades a book instead of refusing it -- how many books does the weight of that one vote actually move?

rules_note.R0_status_quo: the word the producing face printed
rules_note.R1_veto: Y4 False -> REFUSE, whatever the other checks say
rules_note.R2_advisory: Y4 printed and not counted; only non-Y4 checks can fail a book
